label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 16
title: MVP: full test creation/execution/reporting/storage via our test framework - for the dashboard AND every created project
body:
Owner requirement (discovery P8). The dashboard must manage ALL test types for itself AND for every project it creates, using the EXISTING test framework (test-framework/ + core/test_matrix.py, test_adapters, test_framework_integration, qa_cycles, qa_report, qir, qa-manifest) - not an ad-hoc runner. Categories (config/test-matrix.json): unit, db, api, integration, ui, e2e, e2e_bdd, visual, accessibility, performance, security, reliability, scalability, smoke, sanity, install, packaging. Required capabilities: test creation/generation, execution (per category + full cycle), reporting (results, trends, coverage, traceability FR/NFR->tests), storage (per-project results), defect creation from failures, and Go/No-Go. Release blocker.

[OWNER DECISION 2026-09-22] QA TEST CREATION FROM SPECS.
QA / test-framework MUST CREATE tests from the FUNCTIONAL SPEC + DESIGN SPEC + REQUIREMENTS +
ARCHITECT output - not only from code. Spec requirement ids (FR/NFR/US) drive test names and the
traceability matrix; tests are authored per feature (F-x) and executed through the framework.

decisions.note: Tests must be created from functional spec + design spec + requirements + architect output, not only from code
